ns2:section.sectionText: Course description) Designing AHS Career Readiness, is a graded 1 credit hour course for undergraduate students in the College of Applied Health Sciences. This class will cover career planning skill development, self-assessment, as well as life design skills. Students will enhance their toolkit of personal and career development skills in support of their own internship and full-time position search. Course will include class discussions, in and out of class activities, self-reflections, and professional development.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
